title: How to use this course
timingSource: Local Whisper transcription of the official LT download (segment level). Spot-check pending.

cards.title: What this course is
cards.body: The aim isn't only to teach Spanish quickly but to build the thinking habits that make you a confident, self-directed learner. You'll rebuild the language step by step, with a real student learning alongside you.

cards.title: Pause and answer yourself
cards.body: Whenever the teacher asks the student something, pause the audio, work out your own answer (out loud), then press play to compare. These are exercises, not tests — take as long as you need.
cards.caveat: This is the single most important habit. Without it you'll learn about Spanish rather than learn to speak it.

cards.title: Don't memorise, don't take notes
cards.body: Focus on understanding the explanations, not on memorising. Forgetting some things is expected and fine — you can always repeat the course. Keep the language in your head rather than a notebook.

cards.title: Set yourself up to focus
cards.body: Study somewhere calm, ideally with headphones, and when you're rested. A tired mind takes careless shortcuts.

cards.title: Little and often
cards.body: About 20 minutes a day works far better than a few crammed hours at the weekend. If you drift during explanations, take a break and come back. Think slowly to learn quickly.
